messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a base-image rebuild next Wed (2024-09-18). Primary goals: shrink rootfs, rotate cosign signer, and gate deploys behind KMS-wrapped signatures. Need to sync RBAC + audit log path before the canary. :lock:

maria: scope? staging first, prod later? any blackout windows? :calendar:

alex: staging canary on Wed morning, prod cutover Thu if canary looks ok. No blackout beyond 2h for prod; we prefer staged rollouts.

kevin: fyi we hit a vuln in glibc last month — want to ensure signer image isn't using old libc. Also we need to confirm signer pod has kms decrypt perms only in staging during canary.

jules: For RBAC: minimal perms only. signer service account should have: kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt and storage.objects.get for the signing artifact bucket. Everything else denied.

alex: draft iam snippet I used in staging:
```
# GCP IAM binding (example)
roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter: serviceAccount:signer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
roles/storage.objectViewer: serviceAccount:signer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

maria: +1 to least-privilege. How are we capturing audit logs? We need a dedicated log index for cosign verify events and KMS decrypts so CS and Sec can triage.

kevin: we can add structured fields in stackdriver via log router. Suggest log_name: projects/redwood-prod/logs/cosign and labels: {component: "signer", image: "base-sign"}. Also emit JSON 1-line from the signer: `{event: "verify", image: ..., signer_kid: ...}`

jules: please make sure KMS key metadata includes key rotation timestamps. Also, prove that the key version used during canary is recorded in the audit log for later forensic.

alex: noted. infra-bot — can you create a log sink to bigquery for cosign logs and a view for sec?

infra-bot: Created sink `sinks/cosign-audit-to-bq` -> bigquery:redwood_audit.cosign_events. ETA: 2 hours. :white_check_mark:

maria: what about signing key rotation? plan is to generate a new key in KMS, wrap the cosign private key with it, and push to signer secret. How do we ensure previous images still verify?

kevin: cosign signatures embed the public key info. When we rotate the private key, old signatures still validate with the old public key until we revoke it. We'll keep previous public keys in key registry for 90 days. Also add a fallback policy in runtime to accept old key IDs during canary window.

jules: add explicit audit events when signer accepts both key-v1 and key-v2. That way we can trace which key validated which image.

alex: operations checklist draft:
- create kms key + key version (jules)
- prep signer image build with updated libc and strip symbols (kevin)
- push canary base image to staging (alex)
- create RBAC binding for signer SA (maria)
- create cosign log sink (infra-bot)
- run 1k signature verifications as load test (sre-oncall)
- monitor audit/logs for KMS decrypts and cosign verify failures (jules)

maria: RBAC rollout question — is it OK to grant kms decrypt at project-level for canary? Or do we need per-key grant?

jules: per-key grant is preferred. Project-level is too broad. If timeboxing forces project-level, scope it to staging only and rotate immediately after prod release.

kevin: load test note: signer currently stalls at ~1800 qps for verify when image index is large. We should enable streaming verification and bump CPU for signer. Command: `./signer --verify-streaming=true --max-concurrency=64`

sre-oncall: I can run the 1k verify run and capture latency + error rate. Will post results to the thread.

alex: incident prep — if a verification regression happens mid-canary, fallback plan: route traffic to legacy verifier service and pause new image rollout. Need a quick rollback script.

maria: can we add a canary gate in the deployment pipeline that checks BQ table for zero verify failures in the last 15m?

infra-bot: Suggested Cloud Build trigger: `if bq query "SELECT count(*) FROM redwood_audit.cosign_events WHERE result='fail' AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)" returns 0 then proceed`

kevin: test data: I'll sign a set of malformed images to validate failure path. Also will simulate KMS permission denial to ensure logs show `google.rpc.PermissionDenied`.

jules: when you simulate permission denied, tag events with `incident_test=true` so we can filter.

alex: timeline:
- Tue EOD: RBAC PR + KMS key created (jules + maria)
- Wed 09:00: push canary
- Wed 09:30–11:00: load test + monitor
- Wed 11:30: decision point
- Thu 02:00: prod cutover (if go)

maria: blockers?

kevin: need a small patch to signer to emit `key_id` in verify events. I'll open PR now.

sre-oncall: running a dry-run of the BQ sink now; will confirm schema matches expected fields.

jules: sec sign-off required before prod. I'll do a quick audit of the SA and sink once infra-bot confirms sink finish.

alex: thanks all. tagging @here — pls ack your tasks in the PR checklist. :pray:

maria: acked.

kevin: acked, PR created: https://git.redwood.internal/signer/pull/312 :eyes:

sre-oncall: sink dry-run done, schema looks good.

infra-bot: sink `sinks/cosign-audit-to-bq` deployed.

jules: starting RBAC review now.

alex: great — we'll reconvene Wed 08:30 in #eng-runtime for quick pre-canary check.

sre-oncall: I'll post the load test results in that pre-canary check.

alex: end of thread — thanks everyone.
